## Summary
What is changing and why?

## Registration checklist (only if adding an app)
- [ ] I control the GitHub account named in `owner`.
- [ ] I control the GitHub source repository, or have explained organizational ownership for manual review.
- [ ] The requested Title ID is not already registered here.
- [ ] I checked the [PS5 Homebrew Catalog](https://github.com/blackbearreloaded/ps5-homebrew-catalog/tree/main/apps) for conflicts.
- [ ] `app_id` and `title_id` will remain stable across updates.
- [ ] I added one valid file under `registry/PPSAxxxxx.json`.
- [ ] I ran `python tools/validate_registry.py` and unit tests.

## Notes for reviewers
List external listings, migrated identities, or disputed ownership here.
